name: Blattla
summary: Four-player Bavarian point-trick partnership game, simplified Schafkopf with Hearts as permanent trumps.
rules_text: Blattla uses 32 German-suited cards, 8 each. Hearts are permanent trumps. Rank in all suits is Ace(11)-10(10)-K-3-O(3)-U(2)-9-8-7-6, total 120 points. Forehand clockwise may claim a contract; higher seats can overcall. A Normal/Sauspiel caller names a non-trump Ace; its holder becomes secret partner. Solo games: caller plays alone vs three, naming trump suit. Priority: Tout solos > solos > Sauspiel in suit order Hearts>Acorns>Grass>Bells. Play 8 tricks, must follow suit, trump if cannot, highest trump or led suit wins. Declarers need 61 points to win, defenders 60. 91/90 is Schneider, all tricks Schwarz.
